blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Long-horizon and multi-turn agents typically generate short actions and process long observations from tools and environments.
This growing context demands efficient prefill , compact KV-cache storage , and accurate long-context retrieval .
To meet these demands, we introduce HySparse2 , a hybrid sparse attention architecture with two-level KV sharing .
At the outer level, KV Bridging adopts a YOCO-style self-decoder and cross-decoder structure, but bridges only full-attention layers.
The self-decoder uses hybrid sliding-window attention (SWA), while the cross-decoder uses hybrid sparse attention.
The KV caches for full-attention layers in the cross-decoder are generated from the hidden states of full-attention layers in the self-decoder.
At the inner level, HySparse2 retains HySparse’s core KV Reuse design with two refinements.
First, it replaces block-level sparsity with token-level sparsity for finer long-context retrieval.
Second, it removes the separate SWA branch from sparse layers and instead forces a sliding window of recent tokens into the sparse selection.
This two-level KV sharing allows all cross-decoder KV caches to be constructed from self-decoder hidden states.
Prefill can therefore exit after the self-decoder, skipping all cross-decoder layers.
On an 80B-A3B MoE model, HySparse2 outperforms HySparse and Hybrid SWA on long-context retrieval and multi-turn agentic tasks, while substantially reducing prefill computation and KV-cache storage.
blocks.zh:
长视野和多回合的代理人通常会产生短的行动,并从工具和环境中进行长期观测。
这种不断增长的背景需要高效的预填,紧凑的KV-cache存储,以及准确的长文本检索.
为了满足这些需求,我们引入了HySparse2, 一个混合的稀有关注架构,
在外层,KV Bridgeing采用YOCO式自解码器和跨解码器结构,但桥只采用全意层.
自解码器使用混合滑窗注意力(SWA),而跨解码器则使用混合稀有注意力.
用于跨解码器中全意分层的KV缓存由自解码器中全意分层的隐藏状态所产生.
在内部层面,HySparse2保留了HySparse的核心KV再用设计,并进行了两次改进.

这种两级的KV共享允许从自解码器隐藏状态构建出所有跨解码器KV缓存.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Agentic inference combines long contexts with multi-turn interaction.
Across interaction rounds, a short generated action or tool call can return a much longer search result, execution trace, or document that requires prefill before decoding resumes.
As observations accumulate, agents must retrieve and combine evidence across an expanding history, increasing both attention computation and KV-cache storage.
These workloads therefore demand efficient prefill, compact KV-cache storage, and accurate long-context retrieval.
blocks.zh:
代理推论将长上下文与多回合互动相结合.
在整个互动回合中,短促生成的动作或工具调用可以返回更长的搜索结果,执行跟踪,或需要在解码恢复前进行预补的文档.
随着观测的积累,代理人必须检索和综合跨越不断扩大的历史的证据,增加注意力计算和KV-cache存储.
因此,这些工作量需要高效的预填、紧凑的KV-cache存储和准确的长文本检索。

blocks.en:
HySparse ( Gao et al., 2026 ) addresses long-context efficiency by interleaving full-attention layers with sparse-attention layers.
Each full-attention layer supplies both selection indices and a KV cache to the following sparse layers, reducing attention computation and KV-cache storage without distilling an auxiliary indexer module Gao et al., 2024 ; DeepSeek-AI et al., 2025 .
For agentic inference, however, HySparse still leaves substantial room to shorten prefill, further reduce KV-cache storage, and improve retrieval precision.
blocks.zh:
HySparse(Gao等,2026年)通过将全心全意地层与稀有地层相接,解决了长文效率问题.
每个全注层向以下稀有地层提供选择指数和一个KV缓存,减少注意力计算和KV-cache存储而无需分馏辅助索引模块Gao等,2024;DeepSeek-AI等,2025.
然而,对于代理推论,HySparse仍然留有很大的空间来缩短预填,进一步减少KV-cache存储,并改进取回精度.

blocks.en:
In this work, we introduce HySparse2 , which extends HySparse with two-level KV sharing .
Following YOCO ( Sun et al., 2024 ) , the backbone is divided into a self-decoder that combines full attention and sliding-window attention (SWA), and a cross-decoder that combines full attention and sparse attention.
At the outer level, KV Bridging connects full-attention layers across the two decoders.
Each cross-decoder full-attention layer applies its own K/V projections to the input hidden states of a corresponding self-decoder full-attention layer.
At the inner level, KV Reuse retains HySparse’s sharing of KV caches and selection indices within each hybrid block.
blocks.zh:
在这部作品中,我们引入了HySparse2,它扩展了HySparse的两级KV共享.
继YOCO(Sun等,2024年)后,骨干又被分为自解码器,将全注意力和滑入窗口注意力结合起来(SWA),再将全注意力和稀有注意力结合起来的跨解码器.
在外层,KV Bridgeing将全心全意地层连接到两个解码器上.
每个截面解码器全注意层将自己的K/V预测应用到一个相应的自读全注意层的输入隐藏状态.
在内部层面,KV Reuse保留了HySparse在每个混合块内共享KV缓存和选择指数.

blocks.en:
HySparse2 also makes two modifications that improve accuracy and efficiency.
First, token-level selection replaces block-level selection, allocating the sparse attention budget more precisely to relevant tokens.
Second, a forced window of recent tokens replaces the separate SWA branch in sparse layers, allowing local and global tokens to use the same shared KV cache.
All cross-decoder KV caches can then be built from self-decoder hidden states.
Prefill can therefore exit after the self-decoder.
blocks.zh:
HySparse2还进行了两次改进,提高了准确度和效率.
首先,符号级选择取代了块级选择,将稀有的注意力预算更精确地分配给相关的符号.
其次,一个被强制的最近代币窗口用稀有地层取代了单独的SWA分支,允许本地和全局代币使用相同的共享KV缓存.
然后,所有交叉解码器KV缓存都可以由自解码器隐藏状态来构建.
因此,预填可以在自解码器后退出.

blocks.en: We compare HySparse2 with HySparse and Hybrid SWA on 80B-A3B MoE models trained with the same data and schedules. After pretraining, HySparse2 retains broadly comparable general capabilities and improves long-context retrieval. After light post-training, it improves mean MRCR-v2 and RULER-v2 scores over HySparse by 11.30 and 19.81 percentage points, respectively, and achieves lower AgentPPL and LongPPL than both baselines at all evaluated lengths up to 256k. At 1M tokens, our analysis shows 2.92× and 5.02× reductions in prefill FLOPs relative to HySparse and Hybrid SWA, respectively, alongside a smaller KV cache. Ablations show that token-level selection improves retrieval at the same attention budget and that KV Bridging preserves broadly comparable quality.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了HySparse2与HySparse和HySWA在80B-A3B MoE模型上经过同样的数据和时间表培训. 经过预训后,HySparse2保留了大致相当的一般能力并改进了长文本检索. 在轻度后训练后,它提高了MRCR-v2和RULAR-v2的比HySparse的分数分别为11.30分和19.81分,并实现了AgentPPL和LongPPL低于两个基线,所有评价长度可达256克. 在1M令牌上,我们的分析显示,比起HySparse和Hybrid SWA,预填FLOP分别有2.92×和5.02×的减少,还有一个较小的KV缓存. 缩写显示,符号级选择改进了在同一关注预算中的检索,而KV Britching则保持了大体相当的质量.

blocks.en: 2 Background and Motivation
blocks.zh: 2 背景和动机

blocks.en: 2.1 Efficient Prefill
blocks.zh: 2.1 高效预填

blocks.en:
Long-horizon and multi-turn agents make inference increasingly input-dominated.
Tool responses can add substantially more tokens than the actions that produced them.
Reducing attention cost alone does not eliminate the computation needed to propagate these tokens through the backbone.
Cross-layer KV-cache sharing can reduce both KV storage and prefill computation.
YOCO uses a self-decoder to construct a global KV cache shared across cross-decoder layers, allowing prefill cache construction to exit after the self-decoder ( Sun et al., 2024 ) .
Gemma 3n adopts related cross-layer KV sharing to improve prefill efficiency ( Sanseviero and Ballantyne, 2025 ) .
HySparse applies cross-layer sharing within its hybrid sparse-attention blocks: each full-attention layer shares its global KV cache and top- k k block indices with the following sparse-attention layers, though prefill still executes all layers ( Gao et al., 2026 ) .
HySparse2 further incorporates a YOCO-style structure into HySparse, combining reduced attention computation and KV storage with a shorter prefill path.
blocks.zh:
长视线和多转动剂的推论越来越以投入为主.
与产生工具的行动相比,工具反应可以增加更多的象征。
仅仅降低关注成本并不能消除通过骨干传播这些信使所需的计算。
跨层 KV- cache 共享可以同时减少 KV 存储和预填计算.
YOCO使用自解码器构建跨跨解码器层共享的全球KV缓存,允许预填缓存构造在自解码器后退出(Sun等,2024).
Gemma 3n采用了相关的跨层 KV 共享以提高预填效率(Sanseviero and Ballantyne, 2025).
HySparse在其杂交的稀疏区块内应用了跨层共享:每个全关注地层与以下稀疏地层共享其全球KV缓存和上-克区块指数,尽管预填仍然执行所有地层(Gao等,2026年).
HySparse2还将一个YOCO风格的结构融入了HySparse中,将降低注意力计算和KV存储与更短的预填路径结合.

blocks.en: 2.2 KV Cache Compression
blocks.zh: 2.2 动车组 快取压缩

blocks.en:
Agentic workloads require more compact KV caches.
KV-cache compression spans four dimensions: head, sequence, layer, and precision.
Head-level methods share KV heads through GQA/MQA ( Ainslie et al., 2023 ; Shazeer, 2019 ) or compress KV representations into latent states, as in MLA ( Liu et al., 2024a ) .
Sequence-level methods compress multiple tokens into fewer cache entries ( DeepSeek-AI and others, 2026 ) .
Layer-level methods share KV caches across layers ( Brandon et al., 2024 ; Sun et al., 2024 ) .
Precision-level methods reduce the numerical precision of cached keys and values ( Liu et al., 2024b ; Hooper et al., 2024 ) .
Prior work focuses on intra-layer compression along the head, sequence, and precision axes.
HySparse2 instead pushes cross-layer sharing through KV Bridging and KV Reuse.
blocks.zh:
代理工作量需要更紧凑的KV缓存.
KV-cache压缩跨出四个维度:头,序,层,和精度.
头级方法通过GQA/MQA共享KV头(Ainslie等人,2023年;Shazeer,2019年)或将KV表示压缩为潜伏状态,如在MLA(Liu等人,2024a).
序列级方法将多个令牌压缩为更少的缓存项(DeepSeek-AI等,2026).
层层方法共享多层KV缓存(Brandon等,2024;Sun等,2024.) .
精密级方法降低了缓存密钥和值的数值精度(Liu等,2024b;Hooper等,2024).
先前的工作侧重于沿头部,序列和精密轴进行层内压缩.
HySparse2转而通过KV Bridgeing和KV再用来推动跨层共享.

blocks.en: 2.3 Sparse Attention Granularity
blocks.zh: 2.3 注意力分散

blocks.en:
Sparse attention reduces long-context attention costs by restricting each query to a subset of KV entries ( Child et al., 2019 ) .
Its selection granularity creates an inherent trade-off between modeling accuracy and inference efficiency.
HySparse adopted block-level sparsity as a practical compromise, since evaluations showed no substantial accuracy disadvantage and the regular block structure enabled efficient kernels.
Modern agentic workloads, however, involve long-horizon multi-turn trajectories that require precise retrieval from long historical contexts.
Under these patterns, block-level selection exhibits a pronounced accuracy disadvantage, while token-level selection retrieves relevant evidence more faithfully.
Recent advances in sparse kernels also make token-level implementations practical ( Wang et al., 2025 ) .
HySparse2 therefore adopts token-level sparsity for more precise context selection.
blocks.zh:
Sparse关注通过将每个查询限制在KV条目的一个子集(Child等,2019年)来降低长文本关注成本.
它的选取颗粒性在建模精度和推论效率之间形成了内在的取舍.
HySparse将区块级的垃圾堆作为一种实际的折衷方案,因为评价没有显示出实质性的准确性缺点,常规区块结构使高效的内核得以使用。
然而,现代代理工作量涉及长视多转轨距,需要从长期历史背景中准确检索。
在这些模式下,块级选择显示出明显的精度劣势,而符号级选择则更忠实地取回相关证据.
最近,在稀有内核方面取得的进展也使象征性层面的实施具有实际意义(Wang等,2025年)。
因此,HySparse2采用符号级的相扑来更精确地选择上下文.

blocks.en: 3 HySparse2
blocks.zh: 3 节拍2

blocks.en: 3.1 Overview
blocks.zh: 3.1 概览

blocks.en:
Figure 2 illustrates the HySparse2 architecture.
Following YOCO ( Sun et al., 2024 ) , the backbone is divided into a self-decoder and a cross-decoder.
Both decoders use hybrid attention.
The self-decoder hybridizes full attention with sliding-window attention for local modeling.
The cross-decoder hybridizes full attention with sparse attention for global retrieval.
HySparse2 uses two-level KV sharing.
At the outer level, KV Bridging constructs each cross-decoder full-attention layer’s KV cache from corresponding self-decoder hidden states through layer-specific projections.
At the inner level, KV Reuse lets sparse layers reuse the full-attention layer’s KV cache and selection indices within each hybrid block.
blocks.zh:
图2显示了HySparse2架构.
继YOCO (Sun等, 2024.)后,骨干分为自解码器和相相解码器.
两个解码器都使用混合注意力.
自解码器将全注意力与滑动-窗口注意力相混合,用于本地的建模.
交叉解码器混合了全能的注意力,很少关注全球检索.
HySparse2使用两级KV共享.
在外层,KV Bridgeting通过层特异性预测从相应的自解码器隐藏状态构造出每个跨解码器全注意层的KV缓存.
在内部一级,KV 重复使用让稀有地层在每一个混合块内重新使用全意地层的KV缓存和选择指数.

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Two-level KV sharing in HySparse2. FA, SWA, and SA denote full attention, sliding-window attention, and sparse attention, respectively. Left: the overall architecture with KV Bridging between the self-decoder and cross-decoder. Prefill cache construction can exit after the self-decoder. Right: a HySparse2 block with token-level sparse attention and a forced local window. Through KV Reuse, SA layers reuse the block’s FA KV cache and selection indices.
blocks.zh: 图2:HySparse2的两级KV共享. FA, SWA, 和SA分别表示充分关注, 滑入窗口关注, 左:自解码器和相相通解码器之间有KV Bridgeting的整体架构. 预填缓存构造可以在自解码器后退出. 右:一个 HySparse2 块, 上面的符号级别很少注意, 和强迫本地窗口。 通过 KV 重复使用, SA 层再使用该块的 FA KV 缓存和选择索引 。

blocks.en: 3.2 Full-Attention-Only KV Bridging
blocks.zh: 3.2 完全专注的KV 桥梁

blocks.en:
KV Bridging operates only between full-attention layers in the self-decoder and cross-decoder.
Consider a pair of full-attention layers ( i , j ) (i,j) , with layer i i in the self-decoder and layer j j in the cross-decoder.
Let 𝐇 i self \mathbf{H}^{\mathrm{self}}_{i} and 𝐇 j cross \mathbf{H}^{\mathrm{cross}}_{j} denote the corresponding input hidden states.
Cross-decoder layer j j computes its keys, values, and queries as 𝐊 j cross = Proj j K ⁡ ( 𝐇 i self ) , 𝐕 j cross = Proj j V ⁡ ( 𝐇 i self ) , 𝐐 j cross = Proj j Q ⁡ ( 𝐇 j cross ) . \mathbf{K}^{\mathrm{cross}}_{j}=\operatorname{Proj}^{K}_{j}\!\left(\mathbf{H}^{\mathrm{self}}_{i}\right),\quad\mathbf{V}^{\mathrm{cross}}_{j}=\operatorname{Proj}^{V}_{j}\!\left(\mathbf{H}^{\mathrm{self}}_{i}\right),\quad\mathbf{Q}^{\mathrm{cross}}_{j}=\operatorname{Proj}^{Q}_{j}\!\left(\mathbf{H}^{\mathrm{cross}}_{j}\right). (1) Each cross-decoder full-attention layer has its own K/V projections, so layers that share a hidden-state source still construct distinct KV caches.
Each layer also retains an independent Q projection applied to its own current hidden states.
KV Bridging supports different hybrid attention ratios in the two decoders, allowing one self-decoder full-attention layer to supply multiple cross-decoder full-attention layers, as illustrated in Figure 2 .

考虑一对全意分层(i, j) (一, j),在自解码器中分层为i;而交叉解码器中分层为j.

(1)每个交叉解码器全心电图层都有自己的K/V预测,因此共享隐藏态源的地层仍然构造出不同的KV缓存.
每层还保留了适用于自身当前隐藏状态的独立Q投影.

blocks.en: 3.3 Cross-Layer KV Reuse
blocks.zh: 3.3 跨莱尔KV 重用

blocks.en: HySparse2 makes two key refinements to HySparse: adopting token-level sparse selection and removing the separate SWA branch.
blocks.zh: HySparse2对HySparse做了两个关键改进:采用象征级的稀有选择并去除单独的SWA分支.

blocks.en:
In HySparse, pretraining evaluations showed no substantial accuracy disadvantage for block-level selection.
However, block-level sparsity shows a pronounced accuracy disadvantage on multi-turn, long-context agentic tasks.
HySparse2 therefore applies top- k k selection to individual tokens in full-attention layers, and the following sparse layers reuse the KV entries for the selected tokens.
Section 4.3 evaluates selection granularity.
blocks.zh:
在HySparse中,预训评价显示,区块级选择没有重大的准确性缺点。
然而,区块级的相接性显示出了在多转弯,长通的代理任务上明显的精度劣势.
HySparse2因此将上- k 选择应用到全心全意层的单个指使上, 以下的稀有地层重复 KV 条目用于所选指使上.
第4.3节评价选择颗粒性。

blocks.en:
HySparse2 removes the separate SWA branch used in HySparse and supports local modeling by forcing a recent window into the sparse selection.
As illustrated in Figure 2 , a local window of the most recent tokens is always selected, followed by the highest-scoring tokens outside the window.
Both selected sets are read from the full-attention KV cache and reused by the following sparse-attention layers.
blocks.zh:
HySparse2移除了在HySparse中使用的单独的SWA分支,并通过将最近的一个窗口强制入到稀有的选择中来支持本地模型.
如图2所示,总是选择最新标志的本地窗口,然后是窗口外的最高分标志。
两个被选中的集从全心KV缓存中读取,再由以下稀有的分层再用.

blocks.en: This design also enables a complete early exit after the self-decoder during prefill. A separate SWA branch in the cross-decoder requires building a suffix of KV cache from projections of its own hidden states, which further depends on an expanding set of hidden states in earlier layers and grows linearly with depth. This cascading SWA dependency therefore requires the cross-decoder to process a token suffix far longer than the window size. The required states must either be computed during prefill, preventing the cross-decoder from being skipped entirely, or approximated by methods such as bounded replay ( DeepSeek-AI, 2026 ) . HySparse2 removes this dependency by construction and requires no cross-decoder computation during prefill. Removing the branch also eliminates substantial parameter overhead from the separate projections in our gated baseline.
blocks.zh: 这种设计还可以在预填时自解码器后完全提前退出. 跨解码器中单独的SWA分支需要从自身隐藏状态的预测中建立KV缓存后缀,这进一步依赖于更早层中不断扩大的一组隐藏状态并随着深度而线性地增长. 因此,这种串联的SWA依赖性需要交叉解码器处理一个比窗口大小长得多的符号后缀. 在预填时必须计算所需状态,防止跨解码器被完全跳过,或以诸如有界重放(Deep Seek-AI, 2026)等方法相近. HySparse2通过构造去除这种依赖性,在预填时不需要交叉解码器计算. 取消该分支还取消了我们封闭基线中单独预测的大量参数间接费用。

blocks.en: 3.4 The Role of Full Attention
blocks.zh: 3.4 充分注意的作用

blocks.en:
Both HySparse2 and HySparse retain a small number of full-attention layers, as we believe that full attention remains important for model quality.
These full-attention layers also serve as indexers, using exact attention scores to provide oracle token selection for subsequent sparse layers.
This design supports native end-to-end training without a separate indexer or an auxiliary distillation objective to train one.
Full attention nevertheless remains computationally expensive, so we keep the proportion of full-attention layers small. In HySparse2, prefill KV-cache construction requires only one full-attention layer. Following recent sparsification approaches Gao et al., 2024 ; DeepSeek-AI et al., 2025 , we could further approximate the retained full-attention layers with a lightweight indexer plus sparse attention in post-training.
Future architectures could also allocate less computation to full attention and more to sparse attention, for example by reducing the number of query heads in full-attention layers while increasing it in sparse-attention layers.
blocks.zh:
HySparse2和HySparse都保留了少量全心全意的地层,因为我们相信,全心全意对于模型质量仍然很重要.
这些全注层也充当了索引器,使用精确的注意分来为后来的稀有地层提供甲骨文符号选择.
这种设计支持本土端到端训练,没有单独的索引器或辅助分馏目标来训练一门.
然而,在计算上,充分关注仍然是昂贵的,因此,我们保持了全心全意层的比例。 在HySparse2中,预填出KV-cache构造只需要一个全注层. 继最近加奥等(Gao等,2024年;DeepSeek-AI等,2025年)后,我们可以进一步将保留下来的全心全意层与轻量级索引器相近,再加上培训后很少注意。
未来架构还可以将较少的计算分配到充分关注,而更多的分配到很少关注,例如减少全注层的查询头数,同时增加在少注层.

blocks.en: 3.5 Inference Architecture
blocks.zh: 3.5 推论建筑

blocks.en:
Under prefill–decode disaggregation, the HySparse2 prefill node hosts only the self-decoder and the KV Bridging projections.
For the 49-layer model shown in Figure 2 , this requires deploying only the first 25 layers, cutting the memory requirement of the prefill node by nearly half.
With a high SWA-to-full-attention ratio, the self-decoder performs full attention in only one layer during the prefill stage.
We also compute the cross-decoder full-attention KV caches on the prefill node and transfer them to the decode nodes, because the projected KV caches are smaller than the source hidden states.
blocks.zh:
在预填-解码分解下, HySparse2 预填节点主机只有自解码器和 KV Britching 预测.
对于图2所显示的49层模型,这只需要部署前25层,将预填节点的内存要求削减了近一半.
由于SWA对全收率较高,自解码器在预填阶段只进行一层全收.
我们还在预填节点上计算出交叉解码器全取出KV缓存,并转移至解码节点,因为所预测的KV缓存比源隐藏状态要小.

blocks.en:
During pretraining, HySparse2 uses a single MTP layer conditioned on the hidden states at the self-decoder/cross-decoder boundary to aid convergence.
During post-training, this MTP layer could be replaced with a larger DFlash-style drafter conditioned on the same hidden states ( Chen et al., 2026 ) .
Their early availability could support asynchronous drafting and verification ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) .
Training the larger drafter and coordinating asynchronous execution with verification feedback remain future work.
blocks.zh:
在预训期间,HySparse2使用一个以自解码器/跨解码器边界上隐藏状态为条件的单一MTP层来帮助收缩.
在后训练期间,这个MTP层可以被更大的DFlash风格的起草器所取代,条件为相同的隐藏状态(Chen等,2026年).
尽早提供这些手册可以支持同步起草和核查(张等,2025年)。
培训更大的起草者和协调与核查反馈同步执行仍然是今后的工作。

blocks.en: 4 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 评价

blocks.en:
We compare HySparse2 with HySparse ( Gao et al., 2026 ) and Hybrid SWA used in MiMo-V2 Series ( Xiaomi Team et al., 2026 ) .
The overall comparison covers model performance, prefill FLOPs, and KV-cache storage.
We then conduct ablation studies on sparse selection granularity, the forced local window, and KV Bridging.
Token-level selection targets stronger long-context accuracy in agentic scenarios without compromising efficiency, whereas the forced local window and KV Bridging target lower prefill costs while retaining model quality.
blocks.zh:
我们比较了HySparse2与HySparse(Gao等,2026年)和MiMo-V2系列(Xiaomi Team等,2026年)中使用的SWA混合.
总体比较涵盖了模型性能,预填FLOP,和KV-cache存储.
然后,我们进行关于稀有的精选颗粒性、强迫本地窗口和KV Bridgeding的消毒研究。
Token级别选择的目标是在不损害效率的情况下,在代理方案下加强长文本精度,而强迫本地窗口和KV Britching则在保留模型质量的同时降低预填成本。

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
Unless otherwise specified, experiments use 80B-A3B MoE models.
Each model has 49 Transformer layers with a hidden size of 2,048 and uses a simplified mHC variant ( Zhu et al., 2025 ; Xie et al., 2026 ) with the residual mixing matrix fixed to the identity.
blocks.zh:
除非另有说明,实验使用80B-A3B MoE模型.
每个模型有49个变形器层,隐藏大小为2,048个,并使用简化的mHC变体(Zhu等,2025;Xie等,2026),剩余混合基质固定在身份上.

blocks.en:
The models only differ in their attention designs, as summarized in Table 1 .
Full attention in every layer is the strongest reference under our evaluation. When choosing how many full-attention layers a hybrid model uses, we avoid a substantial accuracy gap from this baseline. Hybrid SWA retains nine full-attention layers, as using fewer significantly degrades accuracy. HySparse and HySparse2 each use only five full-attention layers while remaining comparable to the full-attention baseline.
Hybrid SWA and HySparse use GQA ( Ainslie et al., 2023 ) , whereas HySparse2 uses MQA ( Shazeer, 2019 ) , which yields a smaller KV cache and better token sparse attention kernel efficiency.
blocks.zh:
如表1所概述,这些模型只在注意设计上有所不同。
在我们的评价中,每一层都充分注意是最有力的参考。 在选择一个混合模型使用多少个全心全意层时,我们避免了从这个基线中出现很大的精度差距. Hybrid SWA保留了9个全心全意层,因为使用较少的能显著地降解精度. HySparse和HySparse2各只使用5个全注层,而保持与全注基线的可比性.
Hybrid SWA和HySparse使用GQA(Ainslie等,2023年),而HySparse2则使用MQA(Shazeer,2019年),它产生更小的KV缓存和更好的象征性稀有关注内核效率.

blocks.en: Table 1: Configurations of the three attention designs.
blocks.zh: 表1:三种关注设计的配置.

blocks.en:
In HySparse2, SWA layers in the self-decoder use partial rotary positional embeddings (RoPE) ( Su et al., 2024 ) with 64 rotary dimensions and a base of 10,000, while full and sparse attention use NoPE.
HySparse2 therefore requires no RoPE adjustment during long-context extension.
Across the three configurations, all sparse and SWA layers use sigmoid output gates ( Qiu et al., 2025 ) and learnable per-head sink biases ( Agarwal et al., 2025 ) .
HySparse2 uses token-level selection with 128 forced local tokens and 1,024 global tokens.
HySparse selects 1,024 global tokens in 64-token blocks and combines sparse attention with a separate 128-token SWA branch through gated fusion.
Hybrid SWA uses a sliding window of 128 tokens.
blocks.zh:
在HySparse2中,自解码器中的SWA地层使用部分回旋位置嵌入(ROPE)(Su等,2024年),有64个回旋尺寸并有10000个底座,而全和稀有的注意力使用NoPE.
因此,HySparse2在长文本扩展时不需要RoPE调整.
纵观这三种配置,所有稀有和SWA层都使用相接输出门(Quu等,2025年)和可学习的人均沉积偏差(Agarwal等,2025年)。
HySparse2使用有128个强制本地代币和1024个全球代币的符号级选择.
HySparse在64个托肯区块中选择了1,024个全球令牌,并通过入门聚变将稀有的注意力与单独的128个托肯SWA分支结合.
Hybrid SWA使用滑动窗口128个令牌.

blocks.en:
We pretrain the 80B-A3B models on approximately 500B tokens at a context length of 32k.
A light post-training stage adds approximately 100B tokens, introduces agentic data into the training mixture, and extends the context length to 256k.
The three models share the same data mixture and training schedule within each stage.
We use the Muon optimizer ( Jordan et al., 2024 ) with a WSD schedule and peak learning rates of 10 − 3 10^{-3} for pretraining and 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} for post-training.
We report both pretraining and post-training results for overall comparisons, and only pretraining results for ablations.
blocks.zh:
我们用大约500B个代币对80B-A3B模型进行预演,上下文长度为32k.
轻型后训练阶段会增加约100B个活字符号,在训练混合物中引入活字数据,将上下文长度延长至256k.
这三个模型在每一阶段共用相同的数据混合和培训时间表。
我们使用Muon优化器(Jordan等,2024年)进行预训,使用WSD时间表和高峰学习率为10-3-10--3},并使用5×10-5\times 10-5}进行后培训。
我们报告培训前和培训后结果,以便进行总体比较,并且只报告培训前结果。

blocks.en:
The pretraining evaluation covers knowledge (MMLU, MMLU-Redux, MMLU-Pro, C-Eval, CMMLU, TriviaQA) ( Hendrycks et al., 2020 ; Gema et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2023 ; Joshi et al., 2017 ) , reasoning (BBH, MATH, DROP, GSM8K, ARC-C, HellaSwag, WinoGrande) ( Suzgun et al., 2023 ; Hendrycks et al., 2021 ; Dua et al., 2019 ; Cobbe et al., 2021 ; Clark et al., 2018 ; Zellers et al., 2019 ; Sakaguchi et al., 2020 ) , code (HumanEval+, MBPP+, Repo Code PPL) ( Chen, 2021 ; Austin et al., 2021 ; Liu et al., 2023 ) , and long-context tasks (RULER, NoLiMa) ( Hsieh et al., 2024 ; Modarressi et al., 2025 ) , as listed in Table 2 .
Repo Code PPL is an internal benchmark that reports byte perplexity over long code repositories with cross-file dependencies, and therefore also probes long-context modeling ability.
blocks.zh:
培训前评价涵盖知识(MMLU、MMLU-Redux、MMLU-Pro、C-Eval、CMMLU、TriviaQA)(Hendrycks等,2020年;Gema等,2024年;Wang等,2024年;Huang等,2023年;Li等,2023年;Zellers等,2017年;Sakaguchi等,2020年),推理(BBHH、MATH、DROP、GSM8K、ARC-C、HelaSwag、WinoGrande)(Suzgun等,2023年;Hendrycks等,2021年;Dua等,2019年;Cobbe等,2021年;Clark等,2023年;Zelers等,2019年;Sakagu口等,2020年),代码(HEval+、MBPP+、Repo CodePL)(陈、2021;Aust等,2021年;La等,2021年;L
Repo 代码 PPL是一个内部基准,在具有跨文件依赖性的长代码寄存器上报告字节的通通性,因此也探究了长文本的建模能力.

blocks.en:
After light post-training, we focus on multi-turn retrieval and long-context likelihood on agent trajectories.
AgentPPL is an internal benchmark built from multi-turn agent trajectories that measures byte perplexity on the reasoning, tool-call, and response segments of 1,000 trajectories.
LongPPL ( Fang et al., 2024 ) measures perplexity on selected tokens that depend on long-range context, using 349 examples from agent trajectories and long-context tasks.
MRCR-v2 ( Vodrahalli et al., 2024 ) measures multi-round retrieval with two, four, or eight needles.
RULER-v2 ( Hsieh et al., 2025 ) covers 12 retrieval and question-answering subtasks. GraphWalks ( OpenAI, 2025 ) evaluates multi-hop graph traversal.
blocks.zh:
光后训练后,我们专注于多回转回取和对代理轨迹的长文本可能性.
AgentPPL是一个由多转子代理轨迹所构建的内部基准,它测量了1000个轨迹的推理,工具调用,和响应段上的字节的偏差.
LongPPL (Fang等, 2024) 测量取决于长距离上下文的选定信使的迷惑性, 使用代理轨迹和长文本任务的349个实例.
MRCR-v2(Vodrahalli等,2024年)用2,4,或8针来测量多轮取回.
RULAR-v2(Hsieh等,2025年)涵盖12个检索和问答子任务. GraphWalks (OpenAI, 2025))评价多跳图倒转.

blocks.en: 4.2 Overall Comparison
blocks.zh: 4.2 总比较

blocks.en: Table 2: Pretraining performance of the 80B-A3B models. HySparse2 improves long-context performance while remaining broadly comparable to both baselines on general capabilities.
blocks.zh: 页:1 2:80B-A3B型机车的预训性能. HySparse2改进了长文本的性能,同时在一般能力上仍然大致可以与两个基线相比较。

blocks.en:
Table 2 shows that HySparse2 remains broadly comparable to both baselines on general capabilities, while its clearest gains are in long-context modeling.
HySparse2 achieves the highest RULER and NoLiMa scores, improving over HySparse by 5.88 and 9.49 points, respectively. It also has the lowest Repo Code PPL at 1.1570, a small improvement over 1.1588 for HySparse and 1.1578 for Hybrid SWA. Individual general-purpose results show a mixed picture. HySparse2 is stronger on BBH and MMLU-Pro, while HySparse retains an advantage on DROP.
blocks.zh:
表2显示,HySparse2在一般能力方面仍然大致可以与两个基线相比较,而其最明显的收益是采用长写模型。
HySparse2取得了RALLR和NoLiMa最高分,比HySparse分别提高了5.88分和9.49分. 它的Repo Code PPL最低,为1.1570,比HySparse的1.1588和SWA混合型的1.1578略有改进。 个别的普通用途结果有好有坏。 HySparse2在BBH和MMLU-Pro上较强,而HySparse保留了DROP上的优势.

blocks.en:
We next compare the models after the same light post-training stage of approximately 100B tokens.
We evaluate retrieval with MRCR-v2 and RULER-v2 and long-context likelihood with AgentPPL and LongPPL. Retrieval averages weight the reported context lengths equally, and perplexity curves group examples by context length.
blocks.zh:
接下来,我们比较这些型号 在同一个光亮的训练后阶段 大约100B令牌。
我们用MRCR-v2和RULAR-v2评估检索,用AgentPPL和LongPPL评估长文本的可能性。 检索平均值将报告上下文长度相等地加权,并按上下文长度将复杂曲线分组实例。

blocks.en:
Figure 3 shows that HySparse2 leads both baselines on all four metrics at every evaluated length.
The largest gains are in retrieval.
Relative to HySparse, its mean MRCR-v2 and RULER-v2 scores increase by 11.30 and 19.81 points, while the corresponding gains over Hybrid SWA are 6.44 and 18.65 points.
The advantage remains large at 256k, where HySparse2 reaches 58.45 on RULER-v2, compared with 32.61 for HySparse and 35.74 for Hybrid SWA.
HySparse2 also achieves lower AgentPPL and LongPPL throughout the evaluated range, showing that its retrieval gains are accompanied by better likelihood on long agent trajectories and context-dependent tokens.
AgentPPL increases with context length, whereas LongPPL decreases.
This contrast reflects opposite effects of additional context: longer contexts expose more relevant information for LongPPL’s key tokens, but also introduce more intervening turns and tool outputs that make the relevant evidence harder to retrieve in multi-turn agent trajectories.
blocks.zh:
图3显示,HySparse2在每一评价长度的所有四个度量标准上都领先两个基线。
最大的收益是回收。
相较于HySparse,其平均MRCR-v2和RULAR-v2的分数分别增加了11.30分和19.81分,而相较于SWA混合赛的相应得分为6.44分和18.65分.
优势仍然很大,为256k,HySparse2在RULAR-v2上达到58.45克,而HySparse和SWA混合型为32.61克.
HySparse2还在整个被评价范围内实现了更低的AgentPPL和LongPPL,表明其检索增益伴随着长的Agent轨迹和上下文依赖的符号更有可能.
AgentPPL随上下文长度而增加,而LongPPL则减少.
这种对比反映了额外背景的相反效果:较长的背景暴露出更多与LongPPL关键符号相關的信息,但也引入了更能介入的转折和工具输出,使得相关证据在多转折剂轨迹中更难被取回.

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Long-context performance after a light post-training stage. HySparse2 achieves higher retrieval scores and lower perplexity than both baselines across all evaluated context lengths.
blocks.zh: 图3:训练后轻便阶段后长文表演. HySparse2在所有评价的上下文长度上实现了比两个基线更高的检索分数和更低的复杂度.

blocks.en: We compare the prefill FLOPs and KV-cache size of HySparse2, HySparse, and Hybrid SWA, under the 80B-A3B configuration across context lengths from 1k to 1M tokens with FP8 KV-cache storage.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了HySparse2,HySparse,和Hydle SWA的预填FLOP和KV-cache大小,在上下文长度从1k到1M的80B-A3B配置下与FP8 KV-cache存储.

blocks.en:
Figure 4 shows that HySparse2 requires less prefill computation and KV-cache storage than HySparse and Hybrid SWA.
At 1M tokens, HySparse2 reduces prefill FLOPs by 2.92 × 2.92\times relative to HySparse and 5.02 × 5.02\times relative to Hybrid SWA.
The KV cache of HySparse2 occupies only 2.69 GB, compared with 6.72 GB for HySparse and 12.09 GB for Hybrid SWA.
blocks.zh:
图4显示,与HySparse和Hybrid SWA相比,HySparse2需要较少的预填计算和KV-cache存储.
在1M令牌上,HySparse2相对HySparse将预填FLOP减少2.92×2.92\时间,而相对于HySparse则减少5.02×5.02\时间.
HySparse2的KV缓存只占用了2.69 GB,而HySparse的缓存占了6.72 GB,而SWA混合型的缓存占了12.09 GB.

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Prefill computation and KV-cache storage for the 80B-A3B models. HySparse2 reduces both costs relative to HySparse and Hybrid SWA.
blocks.zh: 图4:80B-A3B模型的预填计算和KV-cache存储. HySparse2相对HySparse和Hybrid SWA都降低了成本.

blocks.en: 4.3 Ablation 1: Token-Level versus Block-Level Sparsity
blocks.zh: 4.3 第1项:托肯级对区块级的比对

blocks.en:
We compare block-level selection with token-level selection.
Block-level selection uses a block size of 64.
Both variants use the same backbone layout, select 1,024 global tokens, and retain a separate 128-token local window.
blocks.zh:
我们比较区块级选择和符号级选择.
区块级别选择使用区块尺寸64.
两个变体都采用相同的主干布局,选择了1,024个全局代币,并保留了单独的128个托肯本地窗口.

blocks.en: Table 3: Token-level versus block-level sparse selection after pretraining. Token-level selection improves long-context retrieval and graph reasoning under the same attention budget.
blocks.zh: 表3:预训后选取的托肯级与区块级的稀有选取. Token级别选择在同样的关注预算下改进了长文本检索和图表推理.

blocks.en:
Table 3 shows clear gains for token-level selection on long-context retrieval and graph reasoning under the same attention budget.
It improves RULER-v2 by 6.57 points, two-needle MRCR-v2 by 8.14 points, and GraphWalks by 5.55 points.
These gains are present within the 32k training context.
blocks.zh:
表3显示了在同一关注预算下对长文检索和图表推理的符号级选择的明显收益。
它将 RULAR-v2 改进为 6.57分, 二需要 MRCR-v2 改进为 8.14分, GraphWalks 改进为 5.55分.
这些成果存在于32克培训范围内。

blocks.en:
Agent trajectories repeatedly interleave reasoning, tool calls, and returned observations.
The information needed for a response can be spread across several turns, along with role delimiters and other special tokens that identify the relevant boundaries.
Under a fixed attention budget, selecting a block to retain one such token also spends capacity on its neighbors.
Token-level selection can allocate that budget to individual positions across the context.
The retrieval and graph-reasoning gains are consistent with this explanation.
blocks.zh:
代理轨迹多次互出推理,工具调用,并返回观测.
反应所需的信息可以分散到几个方面,以及角色划分者和其他确定相关界限的特殊标志。
在固定的关注预算下,选择一个街区来保留一个这样的标志也花费在它的邻居身上.
选择肯肯级别可以把预算分配给各个职位。
检索和图解收益与这一解释一致。

blocks.en: 4.4 Ablation 2: Local Window in Sparse Layers
blocks.zh: 4.4 校正2:分层的本地窗口

blocks.en:
We compare three ways to handle local context inside sparse layers: a separate gated 128-token SWA branch ( Gated SWA ), removing the separate SWA branch ( No SWA ), and forcing the most recent 128 tokens into the sparse selection ( Forced SWA ).
All three share the same model backbone, KV Bridging, and hybrid SWA self-decoder. They differ only in how the cross-decoder’s sparse attention handles local context.
We evaluate pretraining results within their 32k training context.
blocks.zh:
我们比较了三个在稀有地层内处理本地环境的方法:一个单独的门有128个托肯SWA分会(Gated SWA),去掉单独的SWA分会(没有SWA),以及强迫最新的128个活塞入稀有选择(强制SWA).
三者都拥有同一种模型骨干KV Bridgeting和混合SWA自解码器. 他们只在交叉解码器很少注意处理本地环境方面有所不同。
我们在其32克培训范围内评估预训结果。

blocks.en: Table 4: Local-attention ablation in sparse layers. Forced SWA remains competitive with Gated SWA.
blocks.zh: 表4:地方关注的稀疏层。 强制西澳大利亚州仍然与Gated西澳大利亚州有竞争力。

blocks.en:
Table 4 shows that local information is necessary for sparse attention. Removing the local branch (No SWA) generally degrades model performance, while Forced SWA remains competitive with Gated SWA on several tasks.
Forced SWA achieves the best RULER, RULER-v2, and GraphWalks scores. Compared with Gated SWA, Forced SWA is 5.08 points lower on GSM8K and 4.99 points lower on MRCR-v2, while LongPPL is 1.50% higher.
We consider this an acceptable trade-off, as Forced SWA avoids additional projection parameters and requires no local KV cache, thereby making early-exit prefill feasible.
blocks.zh:
表4显示,地方信息对于很少受到重视是必要的。 移除地方分会(没有SWA)一般会降低模型性能,而强制SWA在几个任务上仍然与Gated SWA竞争.
强制SWA取得了RAULR,RULAR-v2和GraphWalks的最佳分数. 与Gated SWA相比,强制SWA在GSM8K的分数较低为5.08分,而MRCR-v2的分数较低为4.99分,而LongPPL则高出1.50%.
我们认为这是可以接受的取舍,因为强制SWA避免了额外的投影参数,不需要本地的KV缓存,从而使得提前出局的预填可行.

blocks.en: 4.5 Ablation 3: KV Bridging
blocks.zh: 4.5 3: KV 桥接

blocks.en: KV Bridging is designed primarily to accelerate prefill while preserving model quality. To test whether this design scales, we train 290B-A8B models on approximately 1.8T tokens at a 32k context length, with and without KV Bridging.
blocks.zh: 车牌 桥梁设计主要是为了在保持模型质量的同时加速预填. 为了检验这种设计尺度是否,我们用大约1.8T个令牌来训练290B-A8B型号,其上下文长度为32k,有和没有KV Bridinging.

blocks.en: Table 5: KV Bridging ablation at the 290B-A8B scale. Models with and without KV Bridging achieve broadly comparable quality.
blocks.zh: 表5: 290B-A8B规模的KV Britching膨胀。 配有和不配有KV Britching的模型能实现大致相当的质量.

blocks.en: Table 5 shows that KV Bridging preserves quality comparable to the baseline without it. MMLU and TriviaQA improve slightly, RULER changes by only 0.31 points, and Repo Code PPL is nearly unchanged. LongPPL improves from 3.6053 to 3.4202. BBH and GSM8K decrease by about one point, and DROP falls from 71.37 to 68.17.
blocks.zh: 表5显示,KV Britching保持了与基线可比的质量。 MMLU和TriviaQA稍有改善,RULAR只改变0.31分,Repo Code PPL几乎不变. LongPPL从3.6053改进为3.4202. BBH和GSM8K减少约一分,DROP从71.37降至68.17.

blocks.en:
For the connection scheme, we compare KV Bridging with KV Mirror ( Liu et al., 2026 ) on 80B-A3B models that share the same hybrid backbone and pretraining recipe.
KV Mirror uses U-shaped connections that pair early and late layers in reverse order, → n 1\!\rightarrow\!n , → n − 1 2\!\rightarrow\!n-1 , and so on, whereas KV Bridging connects only the full-attention layers in the self-decoder and the cross-decoder.
Both styles form the target KV representations by re-projecting source hidden states.
blocks.zh:
对于连接方案,我们将KV Bridinging和KV Mirror(Liu等,2026年)在80B-A3B模型上进行比较,这些模型共用了相同的混合主干和预训配方.
车牌 镜像使用 U-形状的连接, 以倒序顺序对上早期和后层, ~ n 1\!\ 右旋! n, ~ n − 1 2\!\ 右旋! n 1等等, 而 KV 接通连接只连接自解码器和相通解码器中的全心层.
两种风格都通过重新预测源隐藏状态而形成目标KV表示.

blocks.en: Figure 5 : KV Bridging versus KV Mirror during pretraining. KV Bridging achieves higher RULER scores.
blocks.zh: 图5:KV 沟通与KV 训练前的镜子 车牌 搭桥能达到更高的RULAR分数.

blocks.en:
Figure 5 shows that KV Bridging is stronger for most of training and finishes at 87.65, compared with 81.28 for KV Mirror.
We hypothesize that full-layer states are better sources because full attention backpropagates through scores across the entire visible context, while SWA restricts these direct connections to a local window.
This denser supervision produces representations that retain more global information for projection.
blocks.zh:
图5显示KV 相较于KV Mirror的81.28.
我们假设,全层状态是更好的来源,因为全注意力反射通过整个可见的上下文的分数,而SWA限制这些直接连接到本地窗口.
这种更密集的监督产生了保留更多全球信息以供预测的表述。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We present HySparse2, a hybrid sparse attention architecture designed for long-horizon, multi-turn agentic workloads. HySparse2 is a more efficient successor to HySparse and Hybrid SWA, with better long-context and multi-turn retrieval, faster prefill, and lower KV-cache storage.
Its two-level KV sharing enables prefill KV-cache construction by running only half of the model, including just one full-attention layer.
Under prefill–decode disaggregation, the prefill node therefore needs to host only half of the model weights.
blocks.zh:
我们提出HySparse2, 一种混合的稀有关注结构 设计为长距离, 多回合的代理工作量。 HySparse2是HySparse和Hybrid SWA的更有效率的后继者,拥有更好的长通文字和多回转检索,更快的预填,更低的KV-cache存储.
它的双层KV共享通过运行只运行了一半的模型,包括只有一个全心全意地层,使得KV-cache的预填构建成为可能.
因此,在预填-解码分解下,预填节点只需主控模型重量的一半.
